title: Al-Qaeda negotiating with Pakistani nuclear scientists after 9/11

tellings.quote: they were negotiating with Pakistani nuclear scientists to try to acquire a nuclear weapon they could use in the United States.

plain: After the September 11, 2001 attacks, the terrorist group al-Qaeda was trying to buy a nuclear weapon from Pakistani nuclear scientists so it could set it off in the United States. Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former CIA officer who worked on the case at the agency's counterterrorism center, says so from the inside, naming George Tenet, then head of the CIA, and his own book A State of Mind: Faith in the CIA. If true, the country came close to a nuclear attack in the years after 9/11.
